capabilities.text: Pick a real substance: water, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, oxygen, argon, methane or ammonia
capabilities.note: ours has water and carbon dioxide (and a typical substance) only

capabilities.text: Draw your own substance from its triple point, critical point and normal melting and boiling points
capabilities.note: ours' custom substance takes the triple and critical points and the melting-curve slope; no normal melting or boiling point

capabilities.text: Draw it not to scale, with the key values written at the axes
capabilities.note: ours always draws numbered axes (log or linear); the triple and critical values are written under the figure

capabilities.text: For your own substance, draw it to scale on numbered axes with gridlines
capabilities.note: ours draws every substance on numbered axes with gridlines

capabilities.text: Write temperatures in °C or K
Write pressures in atm or kPa
Name the regions, letter them, leave blank lines, or leave them bare
capabilities.note: ours: names, blank lines or none (lab_regions); no letters

capabilities.text: Name the triple and critical points, letter them, leave blank lines, or leave them bare
capabilities.note: ours: names, blank lines or none (lab_special); no letters

capabilities.text: Name the phase boundaries, letter them, leave blank lines, or leave them bare
capabilities.note: ours: names, blank lines or none (lab_curves); no letters

capabilities.text: Draw dashed lines from the triple and critical points to the axes
capabilities.note: ours always draws dotted lines from the critical point as the edges of the supercritical region; no switch, and none from the triple point to the pressure axis

capabilities.text: Write the values, blank lines or nothing where those lines meet the axes
Draw the 1 atm line
capabilities.note: the opening draws the isobar at 1 atm; the token shows the switch is live

capabilities.text: Mark the normal melting and boiling points (or the sublimation point) on it by temperature, name, letter or blank line
capabilities.note: ours marks them with the words melts/boils and their temperatures at the axis, with no choice

capabilities.text: Shade the supercritical fluid region
Shuffle the letters
Choose the curve's color
Give the chart a title as text, a blank line, or none
Give each axis title as text, a blank line, or none
Type the axis ranges on the to-scale grid
Choose which lines on each axis are numbered
Choose the label size
Finish the top of the pressure axis and the end of the temperature axis plainly or with an arrowhead
capabilities.note: ours draws plain axis ends; no control
